description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX thread yield behavior, including performance comparison between yielding and non-yielding threads using pthreads.

methods.name: IsYielder
methods.description: Determines if a thread index is designated as a yielder for a given trial, alternating to prevent bias.

methods.name: YieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Function executed by yielding threads, calling sched_yield repeatedly.

methods.name: UnyieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Function executed by non-yielding threads, calling posix::DoNotYield repeatedly.
